_readme: The ONE place the art engine keeps PixelLab facts: tool names, costs, limits. The pre-flight in docs/art/PIXELLAB_ANIMATION.md section 0 re-checks these with search_help and updates ONLY this file (then bump lastVerified). Engine code never hardcodes a tool name, price or limit.
verifiedBy: search_help on the pixellab MCP server (see PIXELLAB_ANIMATION.md change log)

balance.note: run get_balance before any paid step; Tier 2 cycle resets 2026-11-11

importCharacter.name: create_character
importCharacter.note: all direction_images supplied = nothing generated; south must face the camera; reference <= 256x256. A sketch with NO direction_images (4 directions) costs 2 generations at 128 px (M3 hero 2) but 1 at 88 px (Quests PHASE-15 receipts); get_upload_url + curl returns an upload:<id> ref (valid 3 days), not an https URL

customAnimation.name: animate_character
customAnimation.note: custom action_description, one direction per job; 8 frames at a 128 import = a 168-172 px canvas = 4 gens (6 frames = 3); put 'always facing left/right' and 'strict side profile' in the prompt; frame 0 is the reference, drop it

templateAnimation.name: animate_character
templateAnimation.note: exploration only (Tier C); loses props on heavy silhouettes

skeletonAnimation.name: animate_character
skeletonAnimation.note: wait for get_character status completed before submitting; slow (3-8 min)

anchoredSkeleton.name: animate_with_skeleton_v3
anchoredSkeleton.note: Tier B: needs an 18-joint skeleton per frame + first_frame_keypoints; seed fixed; AN5 only, opt-in

notNeeded: PixelLab keys or calls in the app bundle
any generation for Tier A procedural clips
